styles.name: rocket-launch
styles.description: A rocket lifts off its pad, pitches over and flies on, trailing smoke

styles.name: starfield-warp
styles.description: Stars stream out of a vanishing point; progress raises the warp until they smear into long streaks

styles.name: planet-orbit
styles.description: Planet circles a flaring sun on a tilted orbit; the travelled arc lights up and passes behind the sun

styles.name: comet-tail
styles.description: Comet nucleus crosses with progress, trailing a blue ion tail and a long fanning dust tail

styles.name: moon-phase
styles.description: Cratered moon waxes from crescent to full along a curved terminator; stars twinkle around it

styles.name: galaxy-spiral
styles.description: Rotating two-armed spiral galaxy; its logarithmic arms fill with stars outward from the core

styles.name: satellite-dish
styles.description: Parabolic dish on a tripod beams signal waves toward a satellite; progress sets how far they reach

styles.name: saturn-rings
styles.description: Banded Saturn whose tilted rings sweep around it with progress, passing in front and behind

styles.name: black-hole
styles.description: Dark event horizon in a photon ring and lensed halo; the swirling accretion disc widens with progress

styles.name: constellation
styles.description: The Big Dipper links up star by star with progress; a spark traces each new line as stars twinkle

styles.name: space-shuttle
styles.description: The orbiter glides over the Earth's curved blue limb, firing its OMS engines

styles.name: lunar-lander
styles.description: The lunar module descends over craters on its engine and touches down by the flag
